resources.string: Add HomePod to the system media output picker.
Enable the module for System UI in Vector, then reload SystemUI.
Connect to the same Wi-Fi as your HomePod. Choose HomePod in the system media output picker to start sharing audio. Each connection starts at 0% volume.
